items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Lucille had about eight, nine, ten million dollars... Glazer was keeping money for Louis

ctx.x: He'd have about ten grand in his pocket and four, five days later he had nothing. He'd go back, hey, Joe, give me ten more. Joe would give it to him. And this is how he went all the time. Well, all the meantime Glazer was holding the money for him, but nobody believed it. Who the hell would believe that a guy like Glazer was holding money?

But Glazer told everybody. He said, 'listen, I'll give everybody a screwing, but not him.' And so finally when deal with down and Lucille had about eight, nine, ten million dollars, you know, and they could see what the whole deal was, that Glazer was -- was up to his word, you know, but he figured he didn't have to prove that to nobody. He knew he was keeping money for Louis, you know, and he did.
He didn't have to take -- why did he have to take it?
